description: Recover JSON from LLM output: fences, prose, trailing commas, truncation

signatures.name: UnrepairableJSON
signatures.doc: No JSON-shaped payload could be recovered from the text.

signatures.name: strip_fences
signatures.doc: Return the contents of the first code fence, or the text unchanged.

signatures.name: find_payload
signatures.doc: The outermost {...} or [...] span, ignoring surrounding prose.

signatures.name: close_unbalanced
signatures.doc: Append the brackets a truncated response never got to write.

signatures.name: repair
signatures.doc: Best-effort repair of a JSON string. Does not parse it.

signatures.name: loads
signatures.doc: Parse JSON from messy text. Returns `default` only if `default` was given.
